problem.description: One quantified sentence naming the asset and the loss. No causal claim unless cause_claimed is true.

evidence.description: Verifiable records only: event ids, field values, alarm codes, work-order numbers. An empty array forbids causal language in 'problem'.

hypothesis.description: Explicitly unproven explanations, each naming the correlation it rests on.

recommended_action.description: Actions. Under status insufficient_evidence these must be evidence-gathering steps only.

confidence.description: Computed from attribution coverage, evidence channels and warning count. Never 1.0, never chosen by feel.

cause_claimed.description: True only when the evidence gate in references/business-rules.md section 3 passed.

corroboration.description: Structured record-to-event matches. Mere presence of a record never appears here.
